settings.title: Apply Serum
settings.description: Start with clean, dry skin. Pump a small amount of Lumora serum onto your fingertips and gently spread it across the areas you want to treat.

settings.title: Glide
settings.description: Turn on the red light wand and slowly glide it across your face, focusing on the cheeks, under-eyes, forehead, and jawline. Keep the movement soft and steady.

settings.title: Let It Work
settings.description: Relax and let Lumora do the work. Use it for 2–3 minutes per area, then let the serum fully absorb for a smooth, fresh-looking glow.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.subheading: A quick rundown of the things people usually ask before using the red light therapy wand — clear, simple answers so you know exactly what to expect.

settings.question: What does red light therapy even do?
settings.answer: It helps your skin recharge. Think of it like giving your cells a small energy boost so they repair faster and stay calmer.

settings.question: How long until I see changes?
settings.answer: Most people start noticing smoother, less irritated skin after 1–2 weeks of consistent use.

settings.question: Is it safe for daily use?
settings.answer: Yes — the wavelengths used in skincare devices are gentle. You can use it every day without stressing your skin.

settings.question: Can I use it with my normal routine?
settings.answer: Totally. Just cleanse, use the wand, then apply your serums and moisturizer like usual.
